editions.title: This weekend in motorsport
editions.intro: Five rounds are lined up for the weekend of 19–21 September, featuring the Clio Cup Series, NASCAR Cup Series, IMSA SportsCar Championship, MotoGP and NHRA Drag Racing.

items.headline: Spa-Francorchamps
items.detail: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps, Belgium · Sat 19 Sep
items.body: The Clio Cup Series arrives at Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps in Belgium on Sat 19 Sep for round 5.

items.headline: Bass Pro Shops Night Race
items.detail: Bristol Motor Speedway · Sat 19 Sep
items.body: Bristol Motor Speedway hosts the NASCAR Cup Series Bass Pro Shops Night Race on Sat 19 Sep for round 29.

items.headline: Battle on the Bricks
items.detail: Indianapolis Motor Speedway · Sun 20 Sep
items.body: The IMSA SportsCar Championship brings the Battle on the Bricks to Indianapolis Motor Speedway on Sun 20 Sep for round 10.

items.headline: Grand Prix of Austria
items.detail: Red Bull Ring - Spielberg, Austria · Sun 20 Sep
items.body: The MotoGP Grand Prix of Austria takes place at the Red Bull Ring in Spielberg, Austria on Sun 20 Sep for round 15.

items.headline: Great Lakes Nationals
items.detail: U.S. 131 Motorsports Park, Michigan · Sun 20 Sep
items.body: NHRA Drag Racing heads to U.S. 131 Motorsports Park in Michigan for the Great Lakes Nationals on Sun 20 Sep.
